sections.label: The opening
sections.line: RC2 is printed: two A4 review copies from Prontaprint Chiswick, two newsroom pages in the book, and the book team paused.
sections.para: Prontaprint Chiswick printed two A4 paperbacks of RC2, 106 pages each, as review copies. The conductor set the book for A4 itself, after the shop's own conversion came out a bit off, and wrote the shop a page with every option. The edition for sale is Crown Quarto, for KDP and Leanpub. The newsroom's opening spread and title page are in the book, and the twenty-two-agent team is paused until the copies are read.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Printed at A4, not for sale, set rather than converted; Crown Quarto for sale; two newsroom pages; the team paused.
sections.para: Six points: the print, its purpose, the A4 work, the edition for sale, the newsroom's pages, and the pause with the conductor's wrap-up.

sections.label: The book is printed
sections.line: Two A4 copies of RC2, 106 pages each, bound as paperbacks, with the black cover.
sections.para: They are review copies, to read on paper and to bring advance buyers to Leanpub and Amazon. The page the shop worked from is on the book's site with both files.

sections.label: Why A4, and why the conductor set it
sections.line: The shop's own conversion was a bit off, so the conductor set the book for A4 in about forty minutes.
sections.para: Its own stylesheet and chapter-end fit (116 pages to 107, near-empty pages from nine to two), page 5 dropped to make 106, the interior built with the book's own fonts, the cover redrawn for a 6.1 mm spine, and a page with every option on the shop's form.

sections.label: The newsroom's pages in the book
sections.line: The newsroom's opening spread and its title page with the day's timeline are now in the book.
sections.para: The spread was adopted at 00:57 and placed as facing pages at 12:55; the title page replaced the plain one at 13:54. The cover is unchanged.

sections.label: The book team, paused
sections.line: At 13:41 every agent was paused until the printed copies are read; the conductor wrote up the seven days.
sections.para: Twenty-two agents, 4,529 commits, 1,012 releases, 96 briefs, 124 decisions, 3,336 letters, 177 sends-back and three holds. Lessons: batch the human's questions, give layout an owner, make holds say what may continue.

sections.label: Meanwhile, at the Web Summit team
sections.line: At the Web Summit team: a token per agent, CRM keys sealed to agents, a newsroom plan, cards at the same shop.
sections.para: The newsroom's new name and mandate are a plan due Friday 10:00 UTC, not a launch.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: The printing is my word; the team's numbers are its conductor's count; times are UTC.
sections.para: The Web Summit team's people are not named.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The book team's briefs 47 to 55, commits, the A4 lab and the conductor's wrap-up; the book's publisher pages.
sections.para: The Web Summit board items WS-155, WS-170 and WS-177. All read 5 November 2026.
